sections.label: Intro · 录像带入口
sections.note: cassette-box island; isolated wall slabs rise with the choir; distant warm window answers the hook

sections.label: Verse 1 · 教室走廊
sections.note: narrow corridor around three classrooms (meander); a window opens per phrase; locker rows react to taps

sections.label: Chorus 1 · 摄像机取景框
sections.note: giant silver camcorder, flip screen opens; staircase on the jersey kick

sections.label: Post 1 · 屋顶坡道
sections.note: ramp H0->H1 (+3) toward the roof; crown C1 waits after the fall

sections.label: Break · 雪地鹿岛
sections.note: drums cut: drop 7 units into fog gap; snow island with the deer off-road

sections.label: Verse 2 · 窗墙长 U
sections.note: window walls unfold in canon; ramp up 6 to the roof

sections.label: Chorus 2 · 屋顶空椅
sections.note: rooftop courtyard with five empty chairs; outer walls fold out on the hook

sections.label: Post 2 · 跨空桥
sections.note: bridge B1 across the fog void

sections.label: Bridge · 鹿回头
sections.note: fall 6 back to the snow level; deer slowly turns its head at the phrase end

sections.label: Pre · 取景屏
sections.note: off-road camcorder screen shows a sixth chair (E1); claps on 2 and 4

sections.label: Final chorus · 记忆庭院
sections.note: window walls return in canon order, halftone bunny relief panel appears off-road

sections.label: Final post · 网点兔
sections.note: jump +3 to the courtyard rim, road narrows to 1.8

sections.label: Fade · 暖窗熄灭
sections.note: warm windows go out one by one

sections.label: Outro · 录像带合上
sections.note: long straight west into the cassette end box, which slowly closes
